description: Search the Toolocate directory for AI tools that fit a task, optionally filtered by category, price, platform or agent access. Results come best name match first, then most notable, each with a one-line summary, pricing, platforms, agent access (API, MCP, CLI), the official url and pageUrl, the Toolocate page to cite. Leave query empty to browse a category or filter. For the full listing of one tool call get_tool.

agent.description: Only tools an agent can drive this way: mcp (an MCP server), api or cli.

category.description: A category slug or category group id from list_categories, for example "ai-image-generator" or "video".

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page, to get the next page.

locale.description: Language of the text fields and of pageUrl (default en). A tool not yet written in that language comes back in English; its locale field says which language you got.

platform.description: Only tools available on this platform.

price.description: free: any free option (fully_free, free_plan or open_source). paid: no free option. The other three pick one kind of free.

query.description: Short keywords, for example "video editor" or "transcribe meetings". Every word must appear in the tool's name, one-line summary, tags or category name, so prefer two or three distinctive words over a sentence.

name: search_tools
title: Search AI tools
